claim_policy: Existing per-story evidence and required checks remain mandatory.
unknown_limits: Reuse rights for a particular product
Scientific qualification of an individual story

sources.scope: Configured cities and station candidates; not every place worldwide.
sources.provenance: Open-Meteo forecasts/models and the separately gated GHCN station path.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Keep forecast, model and station evidence distinct; a station record needs its qualified history.

sources.scope: Configured fire-cluster selection and available source legs.
sources.provenance: FIRMS satellite detections; an alternate leg retains its own provenance.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A detection or alternate footprint is not burned area, a death toll or proof of fire cause.

sources.scope: US Drought Monitor areas selected by the collector.
sources.provenance: US Drought Monitor analysis.
sources.collection_rule: Fridays on the collector's calendar; existing tier and deduplication guards apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A regional drought analysis is not a local rainfall observation.

sources.scope: US fire complexes returned by the configured NIFC feed.
sources.provenance: NIFC reported fire perimeters/complex areas.
sources.collection_rule: After a successful collection, at most once per collector calendar date.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Cumulative reported area is not a new daily burn total.

sources.scope: NOAA GML series used for carbon-dioxide milestones.
sources.provenance: NOAA GML dated atmospheric CO2 series.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A series milestone is not a local extreme-weather incident.

sources.scope: NOAA GML series used for methane milestones.
sources.provenance: NOAA GML dated methane series.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A series milestone is not a local extreme-weather incident.

sources.scope: NWS warning areas returned by the active-alert feed.
sources.provenance: NWS issued alert products, including their issue, effective and expiry times.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A warning or forecast does not prove the forecast impact occurred.

sources.scope: NHC Atlantic and East Pacific active-storm products.
sources.provenance: NHC active-storm entries and their advisory products.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Keep advisory conditions and future forecast points distinct; do not infer landfall.

sources.scope: JTWC tropical warnings represented by the configured RSS products.
sources.provenance: JTWC enhanced or plain RSS; the serving leg remains explicit.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Keep advisory conditions and future forecast points distinct; do not infer landfall.

sources.scope: Disaster alerts/reports returned by the configured GDACS routes.
sources.provenance: GDACS dated disaster products and explicit route provenance.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: One alert/report is not a complete incident census or a validated impact total.

sources.scope: Significant earthquakes returned by the USGS feed.
sources.provenance: USGS event products.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Earthquake magnitude alone does not certify weather relevance or human impacts.

sources.scope: Flood mapping activations returned by the configured EMS routes.
sources.provenance: Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping activations and explicit alternate legs.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A mapping activation is not a measured flood footprint or certified impact total.

sources.scope: Arctic and Antarctic sea-ice extent series.
sources.provenance: NSIDC series and explicitly retained alternate/cache provenance.
sources.collection_rule: Mondays on the collector's calendar; existing caps still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Series extent and source dates must remain distinct from local ice conditions.

sources.scope: NOAA CPC ENSO index series used by this collector.
sources.provenance: NOAA CPC dated index and transition products.
sources.collection_rule: First day of the month on the collector's calendar.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: An ENSO state is not a prediction of a specific local disaster.

sources.scope: NAO, AO, PDO and the derived NAO/AO alignment.
sources.provenance: NOAA index series; alignment is a derived combination.
sources.collection_rule: First day of the month on the collector's calendar; existing annual caps apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Do not turn an index or alignment into a supported local impact forecast.

sources.scope: Configured marine sampling points; not all oceans or buoys.
sources.provenance: Open-Meteo Marine model/forecast products.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A sampled model grid point is not a buoy observation.

sources.scope: Global ocean SST summary series used by this collector.
sources.provenance: NOAA OISST v2.1 series via ClimateReanalyzer and retained alternate provenance.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A global summary is not an individual coast's water temperature.

sources.scope: Configured regional SST-anomaly boxes and valid sampled cells.
sources.provenance: NOAA Coral Reef Watch gridded anomaly products and native-product fallback.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Qualified regional cells are not a global event/opportunity denominator.

sources.scope: Configured cities with separately enabled PM2.5 and dust windows.
sources.provenance: CAMS via Open-Meteo model estimates; optional OpenAQ station corroboration.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; PM2.5/dust flags and optional station access apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A model estimate is not a station observation; dust does not prove wildfire smoke or cause.

sources.scope: Configured coral-reef sites/regions in the CRW collector.
sources.provenance: NOAA Coral Reef Watch heat-stress products and retained source leg.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Heat stress is not observed bleaching, reef death or a measured local impact.

sources.scope: Configured NOAA coastal-water-level stations.
sources.provenance: NOAA CO-OPS station readings and their station/datum context.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A station water level is not a supported regional inundation or damage claim.

sources.scope: Configured US river stations and explicitly mapped alternate points.
sources.provenance: USGS gauge height plus NOAA NWPS thresholds; Open-Meteo/GloFAS model alternate.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Model discharge is not an observed gauge height; retain the serving leg and units.

sources.scope: Greenland and Antarctica ice-mass series.
sources.provenance: NASA GRACE-FO / JPL PODAAC regional series and retained cache provenance.
sources.collection_rule: Mondays on the collector's calendar; existing annual caps apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A dated regional series change is not today's local melt measurement.

sources.scope: Bounded configured-city selection and rotating rainfall scan.
sources.provenance: GPM IMERG Late daily product; Final archive reference; model alternate remains labeled.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A grid product/model is not a gauge record; product-window and gauge reconciliation remain required.

sources.scope: Provider-returned Snow Today SWE points; completeness is unverified.
sources.provenance: NSIDC Snow Today dated snow-water-equivalent point product.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Snow water equivalent is not snowfall depth; record claims require qualified history.

sources.scope: Antarctic ozone-hole series used by this collector.
sources.provenance: NASA Ozone Watch dated area series.
sources.collection_rule: August–November on the collector's calendar; existing annual cap applies.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A seasonal area peak is not local UV exposure or a health impact measurement.

sources.scope: Configured sampled-city regions and retained daily climatology.
sources.provenance: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive, compared with the configured climatology.
sources.collection_rule: Only when the existing opt-in flag and required climatology allow collection.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Reanalysis is not station observation; samples do not establish a whole-region record.

sources.scope: Retrieved cited events selected by this discovery lane.
sources.provenance: NIFC feed and the existing grounded-search verification path.
sources.collection_rule: Only when the existing newsworthiness opt-in flag allows collection.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Discovery results are not scientifically qualified candidates or a global event census.

sources.scope: Overlaps among retained fire/drought/heat and marine components.
sources.provenance: Derived combinations of the original component sources, not an independent feed.
sources.collection_rule: Each eligible alerts run; existing deduplication and story limits still apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: Co-occurrence does not establish causation; all component provenance and time bounds still apply.

sources.scope: Configured city sample ranked against its attributable normals.
sources.provenance: Open-Meteo temperatures and the collector's retained normals.
sources.collection_rule: Requested leaderboard runs; existing score/deduplication gates apply.
sources.time_rule: Use the product's own date or valid period; collection time is not measurement time.
sources.claim_limit: A sample ranking is not the hottest places on Earth or a station-record table.

evidence_scope: Referenced local code inventory; not live/provider/transitive-source qualification.
